claimBoundary: This sidecar reuses the existing KubernetesPool full-failure production harness. It records evidence only after the engine has proven in-Pod runtime-process failure, distinct busy-Pod failure, durable recovery, exact ownership convergence, replay, ledger/trace/lifecycle consistency, terminal DAG convergence, and warm-pool reuse. It does not introduce a second recovery, scheduler, journal, result-acceptance, or Kubernetes lifecycle authority and does not extend the canonical 37/37 baseline yet.
